serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Oh! After some time a man around my age appears at the door. He has deep, black circles around his eyes and looks like a mess. Does he suffer from insomnia? Even his cheeks appear hollow and his complexion resembles mine, but in an even more unnatural, sickly way. ???: W-Who are you? What do you want at this hour? You: Right. Sorry to bother you, but I’m the one living above and…{{wi}} you know… ???: Huh?! D-Did the Landlord tell you it was me?! You: N-No, not really. I kinda figured it out. ???: Whatever. What do you want? You: Right. {{wi}} Could you give us a break? We tried lowering our voices, but Landlord keeps coming. It’s really embarrassing talking about it… This whole situation feels surreal. ???: W-Well, maybe I’m overreacting a little, but I just can’t take it anymore! You: It can’t be that bad, come on. ???: It’s not really about the sound. Those walls are thick and it doesn’t transfer too well, but… but now…{{wi}} Everything reminds me of her… Oh man… ???: I went through a very nasty breakup recently and all those slurps and juicy plaps are simply torture… It’s not like I don’t get how he’s feeling, but I just don’t understand how it is our problem… ???: We had so many plans, she and I… ???: We were supposed to move together to a bigger apartment… {{wi}}Travel around the world… {{wi}}Buy a dog… {{wi}}Nothing fancy, really, a samoyed or a labradoodle. You: … ???: I saved for a few months and was about to buy a ring… {{wi}}Oh my God… ???: Waaaaaaah!~ Come on, man. The dude started crying on the staircase… ???: We- sniff We were so happy together! How could this happen?! You: Sorry to hear that, but- ???: Was it my fault?! What did I do wrong? Tell me! ???: I’m just a piece of shit… You: … How do I even respond to that? You: I’m sure things will get better. ???: They won’t! {{punch}} Geez, why is he getting mad at me all of a sudden. ???: Was it because of sex? I tried my best! I can’t help my biology… I tried those extenders, but it takes time! What the hell man. You: Listen, we really don’t want to be fined by the Landlord every time we play around. Could you talk with him? ???: Fined?! I never asked him to go that far… ???: I paid him just to give you two a warning. ???: I mess everything up, I’m such a loser… You: Don’t worry about it, that guy… he scammed us both. ???: Sorry about that. I will ask him to stop. You: That would be great, thanks. You: Well, if that’s all I will be going. Bye. ???: {{punch}}Wait! You: W-What is it? ???: Do you think that I could… {{wi}}Maybe it sounds weird, but do you think I could… Just spit it out, man. I’m extra annoyed because he reminds me of me when I got dumped. A weird combination of feelings is brewing inside me. I feel sad, annoyed, angry. Everything at the same time. ???: Your girl…{{wi}} Do you think I could go out with her? You: What. You are about to cross the line, pal. ???: I-I don’t mean it in an odd way! I just need to get my confidence back and casually hanging out with someone would help a lot. {{wi}}I think. You: Why does it have to be my girl?! ???: Any girl would do!{{wi}} Well, maybe not any. ???: Any attractive- You: … ???: …Or even a semi-attractive girl would do, really! I just don’t think I will get out of it on my own and you seem like a nice guy… I look like a nice guy? Since when?! ???: I don’t have many friends and the ones I have barely talk to me anymore, because they think the relationship falling apart was my fault… You: Jesus… You: You ask for a lot, I don’t even know you! ???: Come on, guys need to help each other out! You: I don’t know about that… ???: So? Are you going to help me?
